title: Creesource pack
description:
Retextures creepers to have a mossy look.
Makes them slightly harder to spot in green biomes. Supports several mods.
body:
![Startle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9131d847659c58d4edeecdab51fb76b47a72dd1.png)

Hi, I'm Mauser, do you not like how the creeper doesn't actually blend in with it's surroundings? do you not like how it doesn't look like crunchy leaves? **Do you not like how it looks in general?** Well It's made of moss now.

This resource pack, as it suggests; changes the bright and leafy creeper texture, into a dim and mossy creeper. This retexture also helps creepers _somewhat_ blend in more with their surroundings (in green biomes atleast).

This pack supports the following mods:
- [Crimson Steve's Mutant Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/crimson-steves-mutant-mobs)
- [Crimson Steve's More Mobs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/crimsonsteves-more-mobs)
- [Mutant Monsters](https://modrinth.com/mod/mutant-monsters)
- [Yellowbross's Extras](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/yellowbrosss-extras)
